title: Scenic Sri Lanka with FREE Ella Train Ride
highlights: Discover Sri Lanka, a land where ancient heritage meets natural beauty, from temples and golden beaches to vibrant cultural festivals, offering an experience like no other.
Walk along the iconic Nine Arches Bridge, a marvel of colonial-era engineering nestled amidst lush greenery, and soak in panoramic views of Ella’s stunning landscapes.
Marvel at the cascading Ravana Falls, one of Sri Lanka's most stunning waterfalls, where the thunderous flow of water amidst verdant hills creates an amazing spectacle.
Step into history at Galle Dutch Fort, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and marvel at its stunning colonial architecture, immersing yourself in the rich heritage of this iconic coastal landmark.
Witness Sri Lanka's vibrant culture at the Kandyan Dance Show, where traditional music and intricate choreography narrate tales of the island's rich heritage.
overview:
About the Tour:
Sri Lanka is a undoubtedly the finest island in the world flaunting its endless white-sand beaches with pumping surf, lush tropical jungle, misty mountain towns, ancient World Heritage sites, safari plains where Asian Elephants and Leopards roam in abundance, enchanting train rides through rolling tea plantations and vibrant cultural heritage. 
Embark your tour by visiting the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and witnessing the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways. Prepare yourself for a little challenge and conquer the 1200+ steps marked with good paths and stairs to reach the top of the Sigiriya Lion Rock. Capture glimpses of the incredible 360 degrees view over the whole area from above where every corner has its own unique view. Walkthrough the deep luscious jungle and bamboo forest jungles of Ella and see a massive 25 meters high and 91 meters long beautiful stone Nine Arch Bridge appear through the mist in front of you. Enjoy one of the best views as you witness the sky changing its colors in the shades of orange as the sun sets and meets the blue waters of the sea from at the UNESCO World Heritage Site - Galle Fort.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon arrival at the airport, get transferred to your hotel. Post check-in, spend the day at your leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can head out and discover the historic Colombo Lighthouse, offering stunning views of the bustling port city. Also, you can visit the Independence Memorial Hall, a tribute to Sri Lanka's journey to freedom, or explore the National Museum of Colombo, home to a fascinating collection of Sri Lankan artifacts.

days.title: Visit to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Kandy | Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show
days.desc: Post check-out, enjoy a scenic drive to Kandy. En route, make a stop at the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and witness heartwarming care of the orphaned elephants, including their feeding and bathing sessions. Then, continue your journey, and upon reaching Kandy, check in to your hotel. In the evening, enjoy a scenic drive around Upper Lake, soaking in panoramic views of the city’s landscape. Also, witness a Kandyan dance performance, blending vibrant choreography with traditional music.

items.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage Visit on a Private basis
Lake Drive with Kandyan Dance Show on a Private basis

days.title: Day Trip to Sigiriya
days.desc: In the morning, set off on an excursion to the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site famed for its ancient ingenuity. Once there, ascend the staircase carved into the rock face, marveling at the intricate frescoes, remnants of the royal gardens, and the stunning Lion’s Gate along the way. At the top, discover the remains of the royal palace and soak in stunning panoramic views of the lush forests, villages, & water reservoirs. After an amazing day, get driven to your hotel.

items.title: Excursion to Sigiriya on a Private basis

days.title: Transfer to Ella | Ella Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to Ella, a charming hill town. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, you'll be taken to explore the city and visit the mystical Ravana Ella Caves, connected to the legendary Ramayana. Next, marvel at the architectural wonder of the Nine Arch Bridge, a masterpiece of colonial-era engineering. Also, visit the Bluefield Tea Factory, where you’ll gain insight into Sri Lanka’s renowned tea-making process & witness the cascading beauty of Ravana Waterfalls.

days.title: Transfer to Galle | Galle & Mirissa Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, after check-out, get driven to Galle. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax for a while. Later, you'll be taken on a sightseeing tour of Galle & Mirissa, starting with the UNESCO-listed Galle Fort, housing the Maritime Museum that brings maritime history to life through stunning exhibits. Next, visit the Coconut Tree Hill and soak in the amazing views of the Indian Ocean. Later, relax on the golden sands of Mirissa Beach and visit the stunning Dutch Reformed Church.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe Villa
items.hotel: Villa White Queen by Ceylon Itinerary

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to Colombo. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and relax. Later, explore the city on a sightseeing tour and visit the iconic Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, known for its traditional architecture and cultural significance. Next, soak in the lively atmosphere of Galle Face Green and explore the historic Colombo Fort, reflecting the city's colonial legacy. Also, visit the striking Lotus Tower, offering amazing views of the city and continue exploring other attractions.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check-out from your hotel in Colombo. Then, get driven to the airport for your flight back home, marking the end of your Sri Lanka trip!
